node.title: Re^2: How to dereference array of ref.s?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
versions of perl that have this feature enable or usable

The [doc://perlref#Postfix-Dereference-Syntax] is enabled by default in Perl 5.24 and above. E.g. on v5.26:

$ perl -wMstrict -e' my $q="qwer"; my @a=(\$q); print $a[0]->$*,"\n";' qwer

However, if you want it to interpolate in strings, you do need to enable the postderef_qq feature, for example via the v5.24 [doc://feature#FEATURE-BUNDLES|feature bundle] ("use 5.024;"):

$ perl -wM5.024 -e' my $q="qwer"; my @a=(\$q); print "$a[0]->$*\n";' qwer
